description: Order one or more photos in one request. The person or organisation that pays must accept the licence terms and the immediate-delivery waiver. With a wallet_key (or an 'Authorization: Bearer nkfw_...' header), the order is paid at once from the agent wallet and the answer holds the download links, licences and invoice. Without one, it returns a card payment link for a person, and an order_token.
name: create_order
